---
title: "Freshman breakout model — NCAA women's basketball"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
watchlist <- read_csv("freshman_watchlist_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
backtest <- read_csv("backtest_results.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## What this is

A ridge-regression model trained on 2017-18 through 2024-25 freshman seasons
predicts **sophomore-season impact** (composite of next-season WS/40, BPM, and
minutes growth, z-scored within cohort). It ranks the 2025-26 freshman class
as a 2026-27 breakout watchlist. See `README.md` for method and caveats.

## Backtest (forward-chaining, mean over folds)

```{r}
backtest |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(spearman = mean(spearman), precision_at_20 = mean(`precision@20`),
            auc = mean(auc_breakout), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(spearman)) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
backtest |>
  ggplot(aes(test_season, spearman, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Spearman vs eventual composite, by test cohort",
       x = "Test cohort", y = "Spearman ρ") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 2026-27 breakout watchlist (top of 719 ranked 2025-26 freshmen)

```{r}
watchlist |>
  filter(rank <= 25) |>
  select(rank, player, team, pos, g, mp, ts_pct, usg_pct, bpm, ws_per_40,
         predicted_composite, tier) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(watchlist, aes(predicted_composite)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Predicted sophomore-impact distribution, 2025-26 FR class",
       x = "Predicted composite", y = "Players") +
  theme_minimal()
```
